blurb.text: A northern Japanese wine region at the far north end of the country's vineyards. Its most planted grapes are Pinot Noir and Kerner, then Niagara, Chardonnay and Zweigelt.

sources.name: Anderson, Nelgen and Puga, Database of Regional, National and Global Winegrape Bearing Areas by Variety, 2000 to 2023, University of Adelaide (CC BY 4.0)
